description: This file defines a ProgressController class for managing progress and cancellation in asynchronous tasks, including timeout handling and abort signaling. It also includes utility functions related to abort errors and cleanup of external operations.

classes.name: ProgressController
classes.description: Manages progress state, supports aborting, logging, and timeout handling for asynchronous tasks.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing operation with an error, setting internal state and rejecting the abort promise.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a task with progress reporting, supports timeout and handles success or error states.
